result.description: Compact standalone voice recorder designed for interviews, field notes, and lecture capture. It uses a ceramic-faced microphone housing for scratch resistance, includes onboard noise reduction, and stores audio locally without any wireless connectivity. The device features a simple two-button interface, USB-C charging, and up to 24GB of internal flash memory for extended recording sessions. Intended for writers, researchers, and students who need a pocket-sized audio capture tool rather than a consumer entertainment gadget.
result.title: Northwind Quill 24GB Ceramic Voice Recorder
result.title_description: Standalone pocket voice recorder with ceramic microphone housing and 24GB internal storage.
